results.content: ## Journal of Management Studies's Post. ### **Journal of Management Studies**. 🚨 Call for Papers: JMS & SAMS 2026 Conference 🚨. 📝 Submit by: 5 December 2025. Truth in the Age of Polarization and Artificial Intelligence. As AI-generated content proliferates, organizations strategically shape knowledge, and polarization erodes common ground, the very concept of "truth" is being questioned, negotiated, and weaponized in ways that profoundly affect society, organizations, and our collective future. At the 2026 Journal of Management Studies Conference, we seek contributions that explore:. ✅ How truth is constructed and contested in organizations and society. ✅ The impact of AI on truth, trust, and organizational legitimacy. ✅ The role of identity, power, and narrative in shaping what we consider "true". Selected proposals will be presented and discussed at the conference to advance collective thinking. • Proposal submission: 5 December 2025. Join us in Cambridge to co-create a more nuanced, inclusive, and critical understanding of truth in our field and beyond.
